# Landsat 9 instrument inventory, 2021 launch article

Source: https://science.nasa.gov/blogs/landsat/2021/09/27/landsat-9-nextgen-of-the-landsat-series/
Frozen retrieval: 2026-10-11T13:21:50.748219+00:00
Selected source text; gaps between excerpts are marked. This file is not a live webpage.

Landsat 9 carries two instruments that largely replicate the instruments on Landsat 8: the Operational Land Imager 2 (OLI-2) and the Thermal Infrared Sensor 2 (TIRS-2).
